Sam (AE): Quick sync — MerchantCo POC asks if we can guarantee cold-start latency for peak periods during their 6-hr business window. They want reserved GPUs + autoscale, and customer-managed KMS audit. Questionnaire due EOD Fri.
Priya (SE): What's their QPS shape? avg tokens per request? any long prompts?
Sam (AE): Peak ~1k qps for 30 min bursts, sustained ~100 qps otherwise. Avg tokens in/out ~100 in, ~200 out. Mostly chat-like. Need 99th <= 400ms.
Jordan (SRE): 1k qps -> large tokens/s. We should plan reserved pool + KV cache preheat. For redwood-13b-quant, rough estimate: 6–8 GPUs baseline for steady load, autoscale for bursts. Preheat helps tail a lot.
Priya (SE): I'll run the sim and post numbers. What autoscale policy do we propose? They asked for linear scaling with headroom and graceful fallback to smaller models.
Theo (Infra): Suggested policy: min=6, max=12, scale_step=1 GPU, cooldown=30s, warmup_period=15m, prefer AZ spread. Add a burst-credit pool of 4 GPUs for unexpected spikes.
Mira (Sales Ops): Pricing Q: how are burst credits billed vs reserved? MerchantCo wants a worked example showing token cost during burst vs reserved.
Sam (AE): Yes — they asked for cost for a 750k tokens/min peak.
Priya (SE): Running quick sim, will post numbers. Also need to confirm whether POC uses Hosted with customer-managed KMS or Private deployment. That affects audit wording.
Jordan (SRE): If Private: KMS in-customer-account, we just consume encrypted weights; audit logs stay in their cloud. Hosted with customer-managed KMS supported but needs legal review for key rotation SLA.
Sam (AE): Security questionnaire Q28 asks for key rotation cadence and audit logs retention. Can someone paste recommended language?
Theo (Infra): Recommend text: "We support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS). Audit logs can be exported to the customer's logging destination (S3/BigQuery). Rotation can be controlled by customer policy or our managed rotation with 90-day default. Enterprise retention packages available on request."
Priya (SE): Simulator output (quick pass):
```
Assumptions: model=redwood-13b-quant, avg_seq=300 tokens, batch_size=32
Baseline (6 GPUs): throughput ~420 qps, p95=360ms, p99=610ms
With KV cache + preheat: p95=230ms, p99=420ms
Autoscale to 10 GPUs during burst: throughput ~750 qps, p95=290ms, p99=460ms
Estimated tokens/min @750k -> ~12.5k tokens/s -> sustained token-rate cost X (will refine)
```
Sam (AE): Good — can we commit to a 30min preheat and KV warm strategy for the POC? MerchantCo requested 30min preheat before their morning ramp.
Jordan (SRE): Affirmative. We'll run a preheat job + KV seeding. Proposed preheat command: `curl -X POST https://staging.internal/preheat -d '{"routes":["/chat"],"qps":200}'` and a KV seeding job that runs synthetic requests to prime caches.
Mira (Sales Ops): I'll draft the pricing example: reserved monthly fee + burst token rate + one-time preheat/setup fee. I need the per-GPU token throughput and marginal token cost during burst to finish it.
Priya (SE): One more enterprise blocker — SSO (SAML) integration. MerchantCo needs a 2-week SSO integration window and an SLO test before go-live. Add to timeline.
Sam (AE): Tentative timeline: questionnaire by Fri, week 1 SSO integration, week 2 POC preheat and smoke, week 3 go/no-go. Everyone ok?
Theo (Infra): Ack. I'll provision baseline reserved GPUs in staging, create burst pool, and share KMS ARNs and network notes.
Mira (Sales Ops): I'll update the deal doc with pricing scenarios and a short risk section on SSO/KMS.
deploy-bot: Preheat job scheduled in staging for 2024-06-21T03:00Z :rocket:
Sam (AE): Thanks all — I'll reply to MerchantCo with this plan and link them the questionnaire answers. :thumbsup:
